writeup: TIC 219892238 is a candidate eclipsing binary star identified through automated analysis of TESS photometry. The system shows a primary eclipse with a depth of 4.42% and an orbital period of 68.998796 days, though alternating eclipses differ significantly in depth - a pattern suggesting the initially measured period was half the true value. The detection carries high significance, with a photometric signal-to-noise ratio of 564.6 and pixel-level confirmation at a signal-to-noise of 50.4, though the centroid offset of 7.1 arcseconds warrants attention. No secondary eclipse was detected. The target does not appear in six major variable-star catalogs, making it a previously unknown candidate. The automated screening model assigned this target a confidence score of 0.93.
